blocks.text: Bohat se bacteria ke paas flagella hote hain jo unhen chalne ke qabil banate hain. Flagella ka doosra (secondary) kaam kimiyai (chemical) ishaaron (signals) ko mehsoos karna aur un ka jawab dena hai.

Bacteria ko flagella ki tarteeb ke mutabiq naam diye jate hain. Jin bacteria ke paas flagella nahin hote woh atrichous hain. Jin ke paas ek polar flagellum hai woh monotrichous. Jin ke ek pole par flagella ka guchha (tuft) hai woh lophotrichous. Jin ke dono poles par flagella hain woh amphitrichous. Jin ke poore cell ke gird flagella hain woh peritrichous.

blocks.alt: Paanch rod-shaped cells ek qatar mein: atrichous bina flagella; monotrichous ek pole par ek flagellum; lophotrichous ek pole par guchha; amphitrichous har pole par ek flagellum; peritrichous poore cell ke gird flagella.
blocks.caption: Bacterial flagella ki mukhtalif tarteebein (Figure 2.7 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Har cell ek afqi (horizontal) rod hai. Pehle ki satah saada hai. Doosre ke daen sire se ek lehrdaar flagellum nikalta hai. Teesre ke daen sire se chaar flagella phailte hain. Chauthe ke har sire par ek flagellum hai. Paanchwen ki poori satah par flagella phaile hain.

blocks.caption: Flagella ki tarteebein
rows: Ek pole par flagella ka guchha

blocks.text: Bacteria ka flagellum banawat mein eukaryotes ke flagellum se bilkul mukhtalif hai. Yeh microtubules ke 9 + 2 pattern par nahin bana; yeh flagellin protein se banta hai. Bacterial flagellum ke teen hissay hain: basal body, hook aur filament.

items: Basal body: cell membrane ke bilkul neeche hota hai. Yeh ghoomne wale rings se banta hai, Gram-positive bacteria mein ek jora (pair) aur Gram-negative mein do jore. Rings flagellum ko cell membrane aur cell wall mein jamaye (anchor) rakhte hain.
Hook: ek mura hua (curved) hissa jo basal body ko filament se jorta hai.
Filament: flagellin ka lamba helical hissa jo cell ke bahar tak phaila hota hai.

blocks.alt: Gram-negative envelope ke cross-section mein bacterial flagellum: cell ke bahar lamba filament ek mure hue hook se jurta hai, jo basal body se jurta hai: ek rod jis par rings ke do jore outer membrane, peptidoglycan teh aur cell membrane mein lage hain.
blocks.caption: Bacterial flagellum ki banawat (Figure 2.8 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Upar se neeche: filament, cell ke bahar lambi lehrdaar lakeer; hook, chhota mura hua jor; basal body, ek amoodi (vertical) rod jis par rings ke jore hain. Bahar wala jora outer membrane aur peptidoglycan teh mein hai; andar wala jora cell membrane mein. Rings hi flagellum ko jamaye rakhte hain aur ghoomne dete hain. Note mein likha hai ke Gram-positive bacteria mein sirf ek jora hota hai.

blocks.title: Pili
blocks.text: Kuch bacteria ke paas pili hote hain (wahid: pilus). Yeh ghair-helical, dhaage jaise (filamentous) appendages hain, flagella se chhote aur patle. Pili bacteria ko mukhtalif satahon se jorne ke liye istemal hote hain, aur cells ke darmiyan mating (conjugation) mein bhi hissa lete hain.

blocks.caption: Flagella aur pili ka muqabla (comparison)
rows: Harkat; chemical signals mehsoos karna aur jawab dena

blocks.prompt: Bacterial flagellum ke teen hisson ke naam batayein aur yeh ke kaunsa hissa Gram-positive aur Gram-negative bacteria mein mukhtalif hota hai.
blocks.explanation: Basal body, hook aur filament. Basal body ke ghoomne wale rings mukhtalif hote hain: Gram-positive mein ek jora, Gram-negative mein do jore (extra jora outer membrane mein hota hai).

items: Flagella cell ko chalate hain aur chemical signals bhi mehsoos karte hain.
Tarteebein: atrichous (koi nahin), monotrichous (ek polar), lophotrichous (ek pole par guchha), amphitrichous (har pole par ek), peritrichous (chaaron taraf).
Bacterial flagellum flagellin ka hai, 9 + 2 microtubules ka nahin: basal body (rings: Gram-positive ek jora, Gram-negative do jore), hook, filament.
Pili patle, ghair-helical appendages hain, jurne aur conjugation ke liye.
